name: Nagasawa Mitsuki
source:
Mitsuki is a young, beautiful chemistry teacher at [url=https://vndb.org/c38472]Yousuke[/url]'s school. After Yousuke's tragedy, she insisted on helping him get over his loss. Her kind and gentle support produced a very special student-teacher relationship between the two.

[From [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/565978-tsuki-possession/faqs/28692]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
